title: Ruthless Bar Salts Sour Apple Strawzz On Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Sour Apple Strawzz on Ice delivers a bold fusion of crisp, tart Green Apple and the juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberries, layered with an icy menthol twist. The sharp tang of Apple kicks in first, offering a mouth-puckering sour edge, while the mellow Strawberry rounds out the profile with a smooth, natural sweetness. A brisk wave of cooling menthol finishes the inhale, creating a crisp and balanced fruit blend that’s as refreshing as it is satisfying. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid is optimised for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, ensuring a smooth balance of full-bodied flavour and satisfying vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a comfortable throat hit and fast nicotine absorption, making it a go-to choice for vapers who enjoy vibrant, fruit-forward flavours. Ruthless is a pioneering name in the US vaping industry, crafting expertly blended shortfills and nic salts that push flavour boundaries. Their commitment to premium ingredients and bold profiles makes their e-liquids a firm favourite among vapers.
